{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Italy|Italian cuisine]] 
{{recipesummary|category=Pizza recipes|servings=4 or 5|time=45 minutes|difficulty=2|Image=[[Image:20000227--calzone.jpg|300px]]}}
'''Calzone''' is a popular Italian form of pizza. The word means ''sock'' because the resulting pizza looks similar to a sock.

==Ingredients==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (240 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Ricotta|ricotta cheese]]
* 1 cup (240 ml) shredded [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella cheese]]
* 4 ounces (115 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) any topping (such as [[Cookbook:Ham|ham]], [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], [[Cookbook:Salami|salami]], [[Cookbook:Pepperoni|pepperoni]], and/or [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausage]]) (optional)
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] (10 ml) [[Cookbook:Oregano|oregano]]
* 1 package store-bought pizza dough

==Procedure==

# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven temperatures|400°F]] (200°C).
# Combine ricotta, mozzarella, toppings, and oregano.
# Roll the pizza dough between 2 pieces of waxed paper.
# Spoon the cheese mixture into the center of the dough.
# Moisten edges of dough slightly. Fold the dough over, and seal edges by pressing with a fork.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] until golden brown, about 10 or 12 minutes.
# Serve with [[Cookbook:Marinara Sauce|marinara sauce]].
